newsitem.title: CANADA: Ulster Petroleums expects improved results.
newsitem.headline: Ulster Petroleums expects improved results.

text.p: Ulster Petroleums Ltd said on Wednesday that strong oil and gas production and prices were expected to translate into higher fourth-quarter earnings and cash flow.
Ulster said it expected earnings for the period to hit C$4.4 million or C$0.15 per share, up from C$500,000 or C$0.03 per share in the same period last year.
Fourth-quarter cash flow was forecast to reach C$22.2 million or C$0.70 per share, a jump from C$11.1 million or C$0.37 per share in 1995.
Results for the year ended December 31 were slated to be released in the last week of March.

Ulster said crude oil production volumes during the fourth quarter increased 36 percent to average 9,500 barrels per day. The boost came from development wells drilled at Clive and Slave in Alberta, as well as properties acquired late in the quarter in the Wimborne area, the company said.
It said natural gas output rose 36 percent to 88.8 million cubic feet per day with growth coming from newly tied-in wells after plant expansions at Knopcik, Gold Creek and Montag.
Ulster said 1996 capital expenditures totalled C$127 million.
